plugins.name: ifixai
plugins.description: Independent audit for AI agents, run against the one you actually deployed. Connect your agent's endpoint, simulate red-teaming and operational-assurance inspections against it, and get an audit back: what it got wrong, with the prompt and its own reply as evidence. Graded by an independent judge model that iFixAi picks, against a fixed passing bar you cannot tune. If your own agent runs the judge model, say so, because that run is not independent. Billed in credits and quoted before anything runs.
